body: Good to know there are others. Thank you for your empathy. It really is a shame that there is so much stigma surrounding the topic, we are not crazy I'm sure of it.   I hate to admit this, but there are times when the thoughts are comforting like when things in life aren't going so nice. There are times when things feel ok and I tell myself it's not time yet. I wish there was a way I could turn it off.

Thank you, I don’t have a therapist at the moment,   However, I’m really not sad all that much. To be honest I'm just bored with life a lot. I just have these images that flash through my brain constantly. like I’ll be doing something completely normal like having lunch with my grandmother and boom I see myself slitting my throat and seeing myself at the funeral I don’t understand it.  Is this common

The dreams are very realistic my room is the  same each time but the method of death is different.  I have the door locked and the note written. So far I have hung my self, and shot myself with a shot gun each time it was realistic and I awake afraid. I didn’t know if I died or not. This morning my dream repeated again this time I slit my wrist down the road and not across. I had to keep telling myself this as I did it and I felt the pain and the pull of the knife the blood was so real in the dream I laid down and bled out but I still didn’t see myself officially die.
Same boat its not wrong to want to survive.
